title: Allocate Mailboxes
summary: Given an array of house locations and an integer k, place k mailboxes to minimize the total distance from each house to its nearest mailbox.
statement: Given an array of house locations and an integer k, place k mailboxes to minimize the total distance from each house to its nearest mailbox. The solution must fit within a 32-bit integer.
constraints: Place k mailboxes anywhere to minimize the sum of each house’s distance to its nearest mailbox.
House positions are distinct and k does not exceed their count.
hints: Sort houses; an optimal nearest-mailbox assignment forms contiguous groups.
One group’s distance sum is minimized by a median house.
DP by leftmost unassigned house and remaining mailbox count, trying every valid group endpoint.
Every contiguous partition is considered, and each segment cost is independently optimal at its median.
editorial: Every contiguous partition is considered, and each segment cost is independently optimal at its median.

tests.explanation: Optimal contiguous groups around their medians have total distance nine.
